notes: IMDuel on Ethereum (chain 1): chess played by trades. ENGINE_ADDRESS is replaced by the ChessEngineV5 address from the engine launch (launch/engine.json) before this launch is opened. Constructor arguments in declaration order: manager = $poolManager; engine = ChessEngineV5 (its code is not checked in the constructor, so the hook builds where the engine has none; the address is checked off chain); imd = IMD 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7; minImd 10 IMD and minImduel 1,000,000 IMDUEL: the smallest pile worth one conversion batch; turnBlocks 3: how many blocks a move takes bids for (about 36 seconds). No owner, admin, pause, upgrade path or backend signer. The token is src/IMDuelToken.sol on the standard terms (1,000,000,000 fixed, 18 decimals, the whole supply minted to the factory, plain transfers, no owner, mint, burn, tax, pause or blocklist). The factory deploys the hook and the token and opens this pool (IMD pair, fee 12500, spacing 60) in one transaction; the first pool opened on the hook is the main duel and must pair IMD (afterInitialize reverts otherwise), its other currency becomes $IMDUEL; every later duel must pair IMD or $IMDUEL (NoRoute otherwise; there is no native ETH route). Fee: 0.75% of every swap of its pools through beforeSwapReturnDelta / afterSwapReturnDelta, on top of the untouched 1.25% LP fee: 0.65% to the pool's war chest (the team's pot) worth less at the pool price, 0.1% protocol slice converted into $IMDUEL, half to the main duel's $IMDUEL pot and half burned to 0x...dEaD. There is no opening surcharge and no other charge. Every swap emits URC-2's HookSwap(id, sender, amount0, amount1, swapFee) with the hook's own delta and the rate (7,500 pips). A swap must trade its whole order: one its price limit stops early reverts (PartialFill). Liquidity callbacks are not used, and no liquidity or price is read for strength: a bid's strength is what its trade received as a share of its own team's pot (0% at 0.1% of the pot, 90% from the whole pot; an empty pot plays at the cap). Conversion batches (convert: anyone may call it; convertBatch is the hook's own gas-capped call inside a trade) spend at most 10 minimums; a $IMDUEL pile needs no swap and converts whole. Anyone can add to a pool's pots with fundChest(key, inCurrency1, amount) (tokens approved to the hook, or exact native value); a pot holds at most 2^128 - 1 and refuses more. previewMove(poolId, hash) returns the move a closed window will play given its last block's hash. Known and accepted: the builder of a window's last block can bid in it and try versions of it, run at most once per block and buy within 0.1% of the most hook-favourable sqrt price the main duel had at the start of its three latest sampled blocks (sampled before every trade and batch of it; nothing is bought until three blocks are sampled). Play: every buy bids for its team's next move; its owner is the address in hookData (20 bytes packed or 32 bytes ABI-encoded), else the wallet that signed the transaction, so a trade through any router earns (a trade relayed for a smart-contract wallet without hookData credits the relayer: known, accepted); the biggest owns it and a new top bid must pay more than 10% over the current one; a move takes bids for 3 blocks after the previous one was played, and the first swap after its window plays it through a gas-capped external call to the engine, seeded by the hash of the window's last block (BLOCKHASH, or the EIP-2935 history contract beyond 256 blocks; a hash no longer served gives a 0% timeout turn). An engine failure never reverts a swap: a seeded legal move plays at 0%, and if that fails too the game ends as a draw (reason 6) and a new one starts, so a pool can never freeze; an engine starved by the swap's own gas limit reverts it (NotEnoughGas). Only checkmate pays: a mate takes a quarter of the LOSING team's pot (MATE_SHARE_BPS 2,500) and records it for the owner of the mating move, in the loser's token, capped at twice what that bid paid (PAYOUT_CAP 2) and at twice what the game's trading put into the pots (MATE_INFLOW_CAP 2, gameInflow: the pot fee only, the other pot's share valued at the pool's price; a game played for dust pays nothing, so a pot can't be harvested by fast games); captures, checks, draws and timeout moves pay nothing and the pots carry over. Rewards are recorded as owed and claimed (withdraw(who, c): anyone may call it, it only pays who; withdrawTo(c, to): the owed party, to an address it names, never address 0; a claim leaves 1 wei owed); no reward is ever sent inside a trade, so no recipient runs code while a trader's PoolManager is unlocked (the one transfer a trade can make is the slice batch's burn of $IMDUEL to 0x...dEaD). The hook also keeps per-address play counts for the main duel only (stats(address), players), for badges and display; they never pay or limit anything, and side duels count nothing.
